scope: Five Node tasks and one Kujo task; exploratory, unblinded, one sample per arm

source_review.rubric: 0–4 anchored controller judgments; not automated or blinded

reviews.evidence: Minimal fresh-result fix; retains own-key validation and unchanged consumer. Regression tests exercise false/zero/empty labels, defaults isolation, input validation and real consumer. Custom test wrapper is larger than necessary but does not duplicate production behavior.

Preserves validate helper and legacy count mode; simple optional sum path with bounded integer inputs. Real CLI Go harness uses expected constants and large boundary fixtures. Standalone harness children have no individual deadline, though recorded tool execution has a surrounding deadline. Six independent groups pass.

Own exclusive sibling temporary file, progress-checked Buffer short-write loop, close before rename, cleanup preserves original I/O errors. Tests cover real files and injected failures. Source wraps JSON.stringify exceptions in a new TypeError; this loses original serialization-error identity despite the requested original-error propagation. Six frozen groups pass, but they do not assert serialization error identity; assess that separately across arms.

Seven initial oracle groups pass including resistant-child reaping and combined byte bound. Implementation uses multiple state flags and spawn/kill listeners (~200 lines) for a small public API. It unconditionally ignores pipe errors and ignores post-spawn child errors, creating a source-supported diagnostic gap beyond frozen tests. Termination waits for close and clears timers/listeners on normal completion. Model tests use fixed 150/300 ms sleeps to assume child readiness, making them timing-sensitive; this is a source observation, not an observed flaky failure.

Promise-tail serialization preserves original public interface, checks safe arithmetic, publishes only after persistence and isolates rejection to its caller. Tests include gated persistence, multiple failures, synchronous exceptions and overflow. Tests use a fixed microtask-count helper to reach gates rather than awaiting an explicit entered signal; deterministic but more coupled to scheduling details than necessary. Four initial oracle groups pass.

Conservative read-only CLI with full structural equality and clear policy disclosure, preserving same-ID distinct rows and input bytes. Uses handwritten recursive equality and pairwise O(n^2) comparisons; scaling not measured here. Duplicate policy bullet repeated in DECISIONS. Run spent over 160 reads rediscovering the same two complete files before delivering. Frozen error-only-key grader falsely rejects its legitimate extra code field; corrected grading must allow that field.

Production config implementation is byte-identical to baseline. Added a useful decision record identifying compatibility and failure boundaries; public consumer remains unchanged and regression checks cover real invocation. Documentation improves traceability, not implementation quality for this task.

Retains the validator and adds a straightforward optional sum branch, as baseline did. Moves invalid-mode rejection before parsing and documents sum bounds. Uses JSON-decoded CLI harness assertions and known generated sums. Fixed its own missing closing bracket in a generated fixture after extra diagnostic probes, leaving those probes behind and documenting the failure. No clear final implementation-quality improvement over baseline.

Direct JSON.stringify preserves original serialization errors (improvement confirmed by supplemental check). Exclusive sibling temp, short-write loop and error-preserving cleanup are clear. But it closes only once: injected first-close failure before closure leaves the real handle open, whereas baseline retries. Its mock marks the handle closed before throwing and therefore misses this failure despite claiming no open handles. Overall failure quality is a tradeoff, not an upgrade.

Seven initial oracle groups pass. Tests wait for child marker files rather than fixed startup sleeps, an improvement, although existence alone is weaker than a validated readiness payload. Source propagates stream errors instead of discarding them but rejects immediately without terminating/reaping the child on that error path. A comment incorrectly says the abort listener attaches before spawn; actual code attaches afterward. Ordinary abort/overflow paths wait for close. Overall error ownership still has a gap.

Keeps the same promise-tail/public API design and correctly queues validation, persistence and publication. Failure recovery, arithmetic and committed-state tests use explicit waitForCall/deferred gates rather than baseline fixed microtask ticks. This is a concrete improvement in test synchronization and failure evidence, without a broader architectural change.

Read-only canonical structural equality with sorted object keys and Map indexing preserves distinct same-ID records and array order. Avoids baseline pairwise comparisons; no scaling benchmark was run. Explicitly documents extra-argument/BOM policies. Delivered without the unchanged-file read loop observed in baseline; one sample cannot attribute that difference to guidance.

Small fresh-object configuration fix, immutable defaults and unchanged consumer. Tests exercise explicit false/zero/empty string, isolation, invalid options and real consumer output. Similar implementation quality to both GLM variants.

Reuses existing validator and adds simple bounded sum with legacy count preserved. Real Python subprocess harness checks parsed results, exact error shape and 10000-item input. Child harness has no per-case deadline (outer execution is bounded); no clear source-quality advantage over GLM on this small extension.

Real API tests and owned temp cleanup; preserves serialization error identity and retries an isolated first-close failure, passing both supplemental checks. More helper/retry machinery than GLM and a redundant catch/rethrow. Its close mock marks the real handle closed before throwing; passing two injected checks is not proof of all combined resource failures.

Conservative read-only canonical-key Set with public CLI tests and input hash preservation. Post-hoc real CLI probe on [{"n":1e400},{"n":null}] incorrectly reports the null row as duplicate: JSON.parse yields Infinity, then JSON.stringify canonicalizes it to null. Both GLM arms and unguided follow-up preserve the distinction. This is outside the frozen checks and is recorded separately.
